tariffs.summary: Section 232 proclamation of 2-Apr-2026 (Proclamation 11020): 100% duty on patented pharmaceuticals and their APIs (15% for EU, Japan, Korea, Switzerland; 10% UK; 20% for companies with approved US onshoring plans; 0% to Jan-2029 for companies with MFN-pricing and onshoring agreements); generics and biosimilars excluded (Commerce to review within a year); orphan drugs can get 0%. In force from 31-Jul-2026 for companies named in Annex III and from 29-Sep-2026 for all others.
tariffs.sunView: Sun (CEO North America, 22-May-2026): looking at all alternatives to mitigate; 'marginal impact' in FY27. Sun has three US formulation plants and Levulan is made in the US; product-level sourcing of Ilumya, Cequa, Odomzo, Winlevi, Leqselvi and Unloxcyt is not disclosed.
tariffs.src: JD Supra/McDermott (20-Apr-2026); White House fact sheet (Apr-2026); q4call

organon.terms: Definitive agreement signed 26-Apr-2026 (announced 27-Apr-2026): $14.00 a share in cash; equity value $3.99 bn; enterprise value $11.75 bn (6.2x Organon's 2025 adjusted EBITDA of $1.9 bn; ~4.2x its 2025 adjusted net income of $954 mn). Funding: $2.0-2.5 bn of Sun's cash plus committed bank financing. Organon gross debt ~$8.5 bn (interest ~5.5%), cash ~$0.9 bn. Pro-forma net debt/EBITDA ~2.3x.
organon.combined: Revenue ~$12.4 bn (2x Sun); innovative medicines 27% (Sun 20%); established brands + branded generics 51%; generics 15%; biosimilars 6%; US 27%, EM 29%, RoW incl. Europe 28%, India 17%; 18 markets above $100 mn; 24,000 front-line staff; 150+ markets; top-25 global pharma; No.3 in women's health, No.7 in biosimilars
organon.organonFacts: FY2025: revenue $6,216 mn (-3%): women's health $1,752 mn (Nexplanon $921 mn), biosimilars $691 mn (Hadlima, Renflexis; +13% CAGR since 2021), established brands $3,691 mn (Zetia, Atozet, Arcoxia, Hyzaar, Cozaar, Singulair), other $82 mn; adjusted EBITDA $1,907 mn (30.7%); GAAP net income $187 mn; adjusted net income $954 mn (EPS $3.66); debt $8.64 bn, cash $574 mn at Dec-2025. 2026 guidance: revenue ~$6.2 bn, adjusted EBITDA ~$1.9 bn, interest ~$500 mn. Q2-2026 (10-Q, Aug-2026): revenue $1.56 bn (-2%), H1 $3.02 bn (-3%); Nexplanon down, stabilisation expected in H2-2026; China volume-based procurement and LOEs weigh. China sales >$800 mn.
organon.synergies: ~$350 mn of cost synergies over 2-4 years (procurement, people, supply chain); revenue synergies not quantified
organon.accretion: Management: EPS accretive from day one / first 12 months. Street: Nuvama >40% on FY28E (Apr-2026); ICICI Direct FY28E EPS Rs89.1 incl. Organon (Aug-2026); PL values Sun at 25x FY28E 'combined entity EPS' (Rs2,150 target => ~Rs86).
organon.status: Organon shareholders approved (Jul-2026); regulatory filings completed in all markets, some approvals received; integration management office set up; closing expected Q4FY27 (q1call). Acquisition costs Rs162-167 cr in Q1FY27, more to come.
organon.concerns: Leverage (from $3.4 bn net cash to ~2.3x net debt/EBITDA); Organon's revenue falling 1-3% a year; Nexplanon (15% of Organon sales) faces Medicaid-linked and reinsertion headwinds and generics around 2030; only one-third of the portfolio (innovative + biosimilars) grows (ICICI Direct); dividend policy under review (chairman); management bandwidth.
organon.src: dealcall; q4call; q1call; organon8k; Organon Q2-2026 10-Q summaries (Longbridge, AP, Aug-2026); Business Today (28-Apr-2026)

US now 29% of sales
Control of Taro Pharmaceutical (Israel): US dermatology generics
Taro's price-fixing litigation later cost $200 mn+ (GxMDL)

In-licensed tildrakizumab (Ilumya) from Merck; bought Odomzo (Novartis), Cequa (Ocular), 14 Novartis brands in Japan, Biosintez (Russia)
Built today's specialty portfolio

Pola Pharma (Japan); Winlevi licence

Rs3,405 cr acquisition outflow in FY26
